senses.gloss: m. (ὑδραύλης, hydraula) player on the hydraulis, organist.—Pl. אִדְרַבְלִין.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50">Gen. R. s. 50</cite> <he>א׳ וכרבלין וכ׳</he> there are organists and flute players in the land (or organs and cymbals, v. <cite ref="A00451">next w.</cite>), and such a land should be destroyed? [Comment.—Perh. to be read <he>אַרְדִּיכְלִין</he>.] <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23">Gen. R. s. 23</cite> <he>ארדיכולין וכ׳</he> (<he>ארדיב׳</he>, corr. acc.).
